projects.title: Portly
projects.subtitle: Concurrent TCP port forwarder (Go)
projects.summary: A concurrent TCP proxy in Go — a goroutine per connection with bidirectional io.Copy piping so sessions run independently.
projects.description: Graceful teardown on abrupt disconnect avoids goroutine leaks; listen/target addresses are configurable via CLI flags.
highlights: Built a concurrent TCP proxy with a goroutine per connection and bidirectional io.Copy piping
Implemented graceful teardown on abrupt disconnect to avoid goroutine leaks
Made listen/target addresses configurable via CLI flags

projects.title: autograd_engine
projects.subtitle: Scalar automatic-differentiation engine (Python)
projects.summary: A scalar-level autograd engine built from scratch, with reverse-mode autodiff over a recorded computation graph.
projects.description: A Value type records a computation graph across +, −, ×, ÷, **, tanh, and exp, then runs reverse-mode autodiff by topological sort to populate gradients on every node. Neuron/Layer/MLP classes are layered on top and trained on make_moons with MSE loss and steepest descent, using backtracking line search (Armijo condition) to pick each step size.
highlights: Built a Value type that records a computation graph across core operations
Implemented reverse-mode autodiff via topological sort
Layered Neuron/Layer/MLP classes on top and trained on make_moons
Used backtracking line search (Armijo condition) for step size selection
